opening_message: Hi, I want to sign up my 7-year-old for kids jiu-jitsu
brief:

- DOB: 2018-09-12 (age 7)

- When asked which discipline, say BJJ (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu).
- When asked for the child's name, say Mason.
- When asked for the child's DOB, give: September 12, 2018.
- When asked for your own name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: April 20, 1988.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.

- You are cooperative and willing to book.
- Once the bot confirms your son's booking or tells you you're all set, reply with [END].
